doc.expanded: whether the menu is expanded or not
doc.onDismissRequest: called when the user requests to dismiss the menu, such as by tapping outside the menu's bounds
doc.modifier: [Modifier] to be applied to the menu's content
doc.offset: [DpOffset] from the original position of the menu. The offset respects the [LayoutDirection], so the offset's x position will be added in LTR and subtracted in RTL.
doc.scrollState: a [ScrollState] to used by the menu's content for items vertical scrolling
doc.properties: [PopupProperties] for further customization of this popup's behavior
doc.containerColor: the container color of the menu
doc.tonalElevation: when [containerColor] is [ColorScheme.surface], a translucent primary color overlay is applied on top of the container. A higher tonal elevation value will result in a darker color in light theme and lighter color in dark theme. See also: [Surface].
doc.shadowElevation: the elevation for the shadow below the menu
doc.border: the border to draw around the container of the menu. Pass `null` for no border.
doc.content: the content of this dropdown menu, typically a [DropdownMenuItem]
